extension.description: Suffice chat, skills and cost meters in the VS Code side bar, over the documented app-server protocol.
config.title: Suffice
config.binaryPath: Path to the suffice executable. Empty: look for `suffice` on PATH, then for a Suffice build in the workspace.
config.language: Interface language. `auto` follows the VS Code display language.
config.theme: Interface theme id (see the Settings screen). `vscode` follows the editor theme.
